doc_title: Limited Partnership Agreement of Kestrow Halden Senior Credit Fund II, L.P.
notes: Every modification is a small change inside a long, otherwise identical paragraph and is flagged subtle on that basis (four single-number swaps: closing window 12 to 18 months, recycling cap 125% to 150%, single-Obligor cap 10% to 15%, removal vote 66 2/3% to 75%; plus may to shall on the quarterly fee schedule, a carve-out added to the overhead exclusion, and the second term extension moving from Advisory Committee consent to General Partner discretion), and the new 15% single-Obligor figure duplicates the unchanged 15% limit on Obligors outside the United States and Canada in the same section. Tax Withholding is relocated verbatim from Article IV to Article IX in the same amendment that deletes Distributions in Kind from Article IV, so a system must tell a move from a removal. Six non-material edits (a renumbered cross-reference, a defined-term rename, a typo fix, a rolled privacy-notice date and two rewordings) sit in otherwise unchanged sections and must not be reported as material.

changes.description: Subsequent Closing window extended from twelve (12) months to eighteen (18) months after the Initial Closing Date.
changes.prior_quote: at closings held within twelve (12) months after the Initial Closing Date
changes.current_quote: at closings held within eighteen (18) months after the Initial Closing Date

changes.description: Recycling cap on the aggregate cost of all Investments, including Investments made with Recycled Amounts, raised from 125% to 150% of aggregate Commitments.
changes.prior_quote: shall not at any time exceed one hundred twenty-five percent (125%) of aggregate Commitments
changes.current_quote: shall not at any time exceed one hundred fifty percent (150%) of aggregate Commitments

changes.description: Cross-reference for withheld amounts renumbered from Section 4.2 to Section 9.2 to follow the relocated Tax Withholding section; substance unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: Any amount withheld pursuant to Section 4.2 shall be treated as distributed to the Partner in respect of which it was withheld.
changes.current_quote: Any amount withheld pursuant to Section 9.2 shall be treated as distributed to the Partner in respect of which it was withheld.

changes.description: Tax Withholding section relocated verbatim from Article IV (Section 4.2) to Article IX (Section 9.2); text unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: A Partner in respect of which the Partnership pays an amount exceeding its current distributions shall contribute the excess within ten (10) Business Days after demand, without reduction of its Unfunded Commitment.
changes.current_quote: A Partner in respect of which the Partnership pays an amount exceeding its current distributions shall contribute the excess within ten (10) Business Days after demand, without reduction of its Unfunded Commitment.

changes.description: Restriction on pre-dissolution distributions in kind (only freely tradable listed securities, with a Limited Partner right to require a sale and receive cash proceeds) deleted in its entirety.
changes.prior_quote: Before its dissolution, the Partnership shall not distribute any asset in kind other than freely tradable securities listed on a national securities exchange.

changes.description: Single-Obligor concentration limit raised from 10% to 15% of aggregate Commitments.
changes.prior_quote: invest in any single Obligor and its Affiliates an aggregate amount exceeding ten percent (10%) of aggregate Commitments
changes.current_quote: invest in any single Obligor and its Affiliates an aggregate amount exceeding fifteen percent (15%) of aggregate Commitments

changes.description: Carve-out added to the overhead exclusion so that allocable compensation of Investment Manager personnel performing loan administration, valuation or fund accounting services becomes a Partnership Expense instead of being paid out of the Management Fee.
changes.prior_quote: the compensation and benefits of their personnel, which shall be paid by the Investment Manager out of the Management Fee
changes.current_quote: the compensation and benefits of their personnel (other than the allocable compensation of Investment Manager personnel performing loan administration, valuation or fund accounting services for the Partnership), which shall be paid by the Investment Manager out of the Management Fee

changes.description: Sentence barring Limited Partners from management and from binding the Partnership reworded with identical meaning.
changes.prior_quote: No Limited Partner shall take part in the management or control of the business of the Partnership, and no Limited Partner shall have any right or authority to act for or bind the Partnership.
changes.current_quote: No Limited Partner shall participate in the management or control of the Partnership's business or have any right or authority to act for or bind the Partnership.

changes.current_heading: 6.3 Excuse Rights of Governmental Plan Investors
changes.description: New excuse right lets Governmental Plan Investors opt out of any Investment that would violate a state divestment statute or regulation, with the excused amount called from the other Partners up to 115% of their original share.
changes.current_quote: shall be excused from funding and participating in any Investment if, within five (5) Business Days after receiving the related Drawdown Notice, it delivers to the General Partner an opinion of counsel stating that its participation would violate a divestment statute or regulation of its sponsoring state

changes.description: Limited Partner vote required to remove the General Partner for Cause raised from 66 2/3% to 75% of Commitments.
changes.prior_quote: holding at least sixty-six and two-thirds percent (66 2/3%) of the Commitments of all such Limited Partners
changes.current_quote: holding at least seventy-five percent (75%) of the Commitments of all such Limited Partners

changes.description: Quarterly schedule of Management Fees, Partnership Expenses, fee offsets and Carried Interest changed from optional (may) to mandatory (shall).
changes.prior_quote: The General Partner may also furnish, within forty-five (45) days after each quarter end, a schedule setting out in reasonable detail the Management Fees
changes.current_quote: The General Partner shall also furnish, within forty-five (45) days after each quarter end, a schedule setting out in reasonable detail the Management Fees

changes.description: Defined term Confidential Information renamed Fund Information consistently throughout the section; scope of the obligation unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: received in connection with its interest ("Confidential Information")
changes.current_quote: received in connection with its interest ("Fund Information")

changes.description: New annual ESG reporting obligation (responsible investment policy, declined Obligors, Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, board independence) due within 120 days after each fiscal year starting with fiscal year 2026, plus notice to the Advisory Committee within 15 Business Days of any Obligor fatality or governmental enforcement action.
changes.current_quote: commencing with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, the General Partner shall deliver to each Limited Partner a report on environmental, social and governance matters relating to the Investments

changes.description: Typo corrected from reasonbly to reasonably.
changes.prior_quote: such other information as is reasonbly required for its income tax returns
changes.current_quote: such other information as is reasonably required for its income tax returns

changes.description: Second one-year term extension no longer requires Advisory Committee consent; both extensions are now in the General Partner's discretion.
changes.prior_quote: for up to two (2) consecutive periods of one (1) year each, the first in its discretion and the second with the consent of the Advisory Committee
changes.current_quote: for up to two (2) consecutive periods of one (1) year each, in each case in its discretion

changes.description: Privacy notice date rolled forward from February 3, 2025 to January 5, 2026.
changes.prior_quote: privacy notice of the Partnership dated February 3, 2025
changes.current_quote: privacy notice of the Partnership dated January 5, 2026

changes.description: Counterparts sentence reworded with identical meaning.
changes.prior_quote: This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.
changes.current_quote: This Agreement may be executed in multiple counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute a single instrument.
